prompt:
Night, open farmland in 1924: a black steam locomotive halted on the line, its headlamp blazing sideways through great rolling clouds of white steam that fill the frame. Seen from low in the trackside ditch with a 35mm lens looking up at the roof of a dark-red wooden mail car. BOTTLE, PLUM, SILVER and RUST are in the shot, their masks and suits exactly as in the attached reference image. On the roof BOTTLE heaves a plain canvas mail sack down to a black 1932 Ford sedan with its doors open, where RUST catches it. Beside Bottle, PLUM and SILVER face the lens, gloved fists punching the air. Each mask is hand-knitted rib wool in its own colour, smooth knit where the face would be, a large white wool ring round the face and a rounded red felt triangle over the left eye, on the right of the picture. Car headlights glow amber through the steam.

Thanks.
